beats.say: Mortimer and Whitehouse return tonight on BBC Two for series nine with Ted's final appearance.
The beloved Patterdale Terrier sadly died in April 2026, before this ninth series was even aired.
Ted joined the show in season three, quickly becoming a firm favourite beside the water with viewers.
The programme was first broadcast on BBC Two back on 20 June 2018, beginning a gentle phenomenon.
It all started after Mortimer underwent emergency triple heart bypass surgery back in 2015, changing everything.

facts: Mortimer and Whitehouse Gone Fishing returns for a ninth series from 9pm on Sunday 25 October on BBC iPlayer and BBC Two.
Ted the Patterdale Terrier died in April 2026 before his final appearance in series 9 was aired.
Ted was introduced to the show in season 3.
The series was first broadcast on BBC Two on 20 June 2018.
In 2015 Mortimer underwent emergency triple heart bypass surgery.
